Per Court :
1. Heard the learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.P.P
for the respondent/State.
2. Perused the F.I.R.
It has been alleged that the police tried to stop the vehicle as they got suspicion but the driver tried to kill the police officer on duty by his vehicle.
The report was lodged against unknown person.
Nothing is to be recovered from the applicants.
The charge sheet has been filed.
Considering the facts they deserve bail.
